fields.name: compressive_strength_class
fields.rationale: The compressive strength class (e.g., C8/10) is a key property of concrete that indicates its load-bearing capacity, which is crucial for structural applications.

fields.name: exposure_class
fields.rationale: The exposure class (e.g., X0) indicates the environmental conditions the concrete is designed to withstand, which is important for durability and longevity.

fields.name: consistency_class
fields.rationale: The consistency class (e.g., F3) describes the workability of the concrete mix, which affects how it can be placed and compacted on site.

fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a fundamental property of concrete that affects its weight and structural performance.
